description.value: Park Drive is a bar and restaurant on Commercial Drive in Vancouver that also operates The Gemm, a cocktail lounge on the same premises. The menu ranges from craft cocktails and local draft beer to eclectic pub fare including Detroit-style pizza and bao buns. It sits on one of Vancouver's busiest and most cycle-traveled urban streets.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 91m; rack at 95m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Park Drive is an active bar and restaurant at 1815 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, matching the OSM address; the address is corroborated but the phone number does not appear in the fetched website text. The OSM tags cuisine=greek and brewery=yes are not supported by the website — the menu is eclectic pub food and the beers listed are from Parallel 49 and Driftwood with no house brewing mentioned. No cycling amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the website, so most criteria are null; vegetarian options are confirmed from the menu.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Park Drive is a legitimate, operating bar and restaurant on a major cycling corridor, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; a site visit or direct contact is needed before inclusion.
